tasks.label: Debug worker pthread argument
tasks.command: mkdir -p /tmp/uptime-gdb-worker2 && cd /tmp/uptime-gdb-worker2 && gdb --batch -ex 'set pagination off' -ex 'set breakpoint pending on' -ex 'set env TERM xterm-256color' -ex 'break worker_main' -ex run -ex 'print argument' -ex 'print state' -ex 'print state->database' -ex bt --args /lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2 /mnt/media/Folders/Documents/Projects/C-C++/ideapad/uptime-console

tasks.label: Inspect worker argument in GDB
tasks.command: cd /tmp/uptime-gdb-worker2 && gdb --batch -ex 'set pagination off' -ex 'set exec-wrapper /lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2' -ex 'break worker_main' -ex run -ex 'print argument' -ex 'print state' -ex 'print state->database' -ex bt --args /mnt/media/Folders/Documents/Projects/C-C++/ideapad/uptime-console

tasks.label: Trace AppState pthread handoff
tasks.command: cd /tmp/uptime-gdb-worker2 && gdb --batch -ex 'set pagination off' -ex 'set exec-wrapper /lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2' -ex 'break main' -ex 'break worker_main' -ex run -ex 'info threads' -ex 'print argument' -ex 'print state' -ex 'print state->database' -ex bt --args /mnt/media/Folders/Documents/Projects/C-C++/ideapad/uptime-console
